feeding_claim.verbatim: Grass finished beef for Atlanta and North Georgia from the Georgia Beef Company comes from cattle raised on grass pastures only, as the name implies.

resold_note: Pork is sourced from nearby farms.
notes: Unpublished 2026-11-22: the next Verifier should confirm that the Georgia Beef Company sells cattle from its own Bridges Angus Farm herd rather than marketing cattle from other Georgia farms (the about page says the family bought the Bridges Angus herd in 2005 but also that the company markets Black Angus cattle born and raised in Georgia; shop links go to a Bridges Angus storefront, bridgesangusfarmllc.com, not opened). Also check whether the Certified Angus Beef Prime steaks delivered to the door are from its own cattle, and what the 100% High Quality Grains badge on the grass-finished page means. Grass-finished quote confirmed. Live animals bought by deposit and picked up at the processor; no sizes named.
